page.overview:
What is Aquanauts?

The Aquanauts are one of the two factions that appeared with the introduction of Aquazone in 1995.

The Aquanauts are a group of miners based at the Neptune Discovery Lab, who utillise submarines and submersibles of all shapes and sizes to look for Hydrolator crystals to make oxygen and support underwater life. In the original Aquazone line, the heroic Aquanaut miners fight against the villainous Aquasharks for control of the crystal mines.

The yellow base colour of the subs and the bowl-shaped cockpit pieces give the Aquanauts a rather realistic appearance that is close to actual mini submarines. However, the second wave in 1996 brings a vessel that features wheels.
